deploy-bot: Requested staged rollout: v3.2.4 -> 3% traffic (eu-west). Preflight checks started by @alex.

deploy-bot: Preflight results:
```
checks: [schema, model-compat, kvcache-heat]
metrics baseline OK
embedding-regression: potential drift +0.9% on sample set 'embed-smoke-3'
```

alex: saw the preflight note about embedding drift. small but non-zero. can we isolate to a single shard?
maria: hmm, +0.9% is borderline. What's the signal window?
product-ops: signal window is 20m on the eval harness. this is on a small weighted prompt set. not all traffic will hit it.
sre-ina: any errors/5xx spike? telemetry looks fine, but p50->p95 on kvcache increased ~30ms during load test. might be related.
jordan: if kvcache latency creeps we could see tail amplification. i'd vote hold until we confirm it's not infra.
alex: i'm thinking quick 3% warmup is fine but hold the progressive ramp. if drift persists after 3% we freeze and pin back.
maria: prefer to stop before shifting more. request quick A/B on the failing prompt subset.
deploy-bot: Executing traffic shift to 3%...
```
action: shift_traffic(v3.2.4, 0.03)
status: in_progress
```

product-ops: tagging `embed-smoke-3` set to observe. please post evals at +5m and +15m.
sre-ina: running a targeted KV cache evict test against canary nodes now. will report in ~7m.
alex: if kvcache evict increases latency, plan B = pin back to v3.2.3 and rollback traffic to 0%.
maria: agreed. also prepare release notes blurb in case rollback. short, clear.
jordan: creating quick revert playbook snippet in #eng-oncall. copy-paste-ready.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete: 3% -> v3.2.4. canary instances healthy.

product-ops: +5m eval: embed regression still ~+0.85% on that set, but global metrics unchanged.
sre-ina: kvcache evict test produced p95 spike on canary +120ms for ~30s, correlates with bursts.
alex: that's our tether. hold ramp. do not move to 10%.
maria: vote=hold :thumbsup:
product-ops: vote recorded: hold. scheduling quick postmortem if it doesn't trend down in 30m.
jordan: i've prepared pin rollout commands and a rollback snippet: `rb v3.2.3 && pin v3.2.3 --reason "canary kvcache-latency"`
deploy-bot: Noted. Rollout paused at 3% by operator hold. No automated rollback initiated.
alex: team, action items: (1) SRE continue kvcache root-cause, (2) ML run targeted eval and share diffs, (3) Product prepare release-note rollback wording. reconvene in 20m.
maria: will update stakeholders and mark change window as "paused" in the tracker. :rotating_light:
